status.name: loan status
status.gotchas: LoanStatusEnum (e.g. Active); distinct from lifeCycle which carries Defaulted/Repaid

lifeCycle.name: loan life-cycle stage
lifeCycle.gotchas: LoanLifeCycle enum (Active/Defaulted/Repaid/...); this is where default shows, not status

commitment.name: total commitment
commitment.gotchas: This is the headline commitment; terms[].approvedPrincipal/proposedPrincipal carry the same figure per-term version | Headline commitment is duplicated as terms[].approvedPrincipal/proposedPrincipal per term version — the same money, not additive. Use commitment OR a single chosen term, never both summed.

annualInterestRate.name: annual interest rate
annualInterestRate.gotchas: PERCENT not fraction (example 15 = 15%); do not divide by 100 again

endDate.name: loan end date
endDate.gotchas: Contractual end; scheduleEndDate/scheduleExpectedEndDate are computed schedule horizons

scheduleEndDate.name: schedule end date
scheduleEndDate.gotchas: Computed schedule horizon (example == today's date for a defaulted loan); not the contractual maturity

closingDate.name: closing date
closingDate.gotchas: Often null; contractClosingDate is the contractual variant

repaymentStrategy[].name: repayment waterfall order
repaymentStrategy[].gotchas: InstallmentComponentType enum list (e.g. Penalties first); order matters

summary.totalOutstanding.principal.name: outstanding principal
summary.totalOutstanding.principal.gotchas: Use THIS for an interest basis, NOT totalOutstanding.total (which is net of fee/credit components)

summary.totalOutstanding.total.name: total outstanding (net)
summary.totalOutstanding.total.gotchas: NET of fee/credit components — NOT principal; example 31.87M vs principal 27.24M. For an interest basis use .principal

summary.totalOutstanding.totalPenalties.name: outstanding penalties
summary.totalOutstanding.totalPenalties.gotchas: Penalties here are the default/late-interest bucket

summary.totalOutstanding.capitalizedBala.name: capitalized balance (memo)
summary.totalOutstanding.capitalizedBala.gotchas: NON-additive MEMO — equals principal; do NOT add into a sum

summary.totalDue.total.name: total amount due
summary.totalDue.total.gotchas: NET of components like the outstanding block; for principal-only use .principal

summary.totalPaid.total.name: total paid
summary.totalPaid.total.gotchas: Like the other .total buckets (totalOutstanding/totalDue/overdue), this is NET of fee/credit components — NOT a gross sum of cash received. For principal-only paid use .principal; do not treat .total as gross amount paid.

summary.totalPaid.principal.name: principal paid
summary.totalPaid.principal.gotchas: Can be 0 even when interest/fees paid (interest-only loan)

summary.totalExpected.total.name: total expected (life-of-loan)
summary.totalExpected.total.gotchas: Full-term projection; totalExpectedToDate is the as-of-today cut | Same component-netting as the other .total fields — NET, not a gross life-of-loan cash projection. Use the component sub-fields (interest, principal) for a gross basis; totalExpectedToDate.total is the as-of-today net cut.

repaymentSchedule.loanKPIs.irr.name: IRR
repaymentSchedule.loanKPIs.irr.gotchas: PERCENT (example 31.4 = 31.4%); IncludingEquity variant folds in equity legs

repaymentSchedule.scheduleTable[].outsta.name: period-end principal outstanding
repaymentSchedule.scheduleTable[].outsta.gotchas: Per-row running balance, not the loan-level outstanding

repaymentSchedule.scheduleTable[].outsta.name: period-end total outstanding
repaymentSchedule.scheduleTable[].outsta.gotchas: Net of components; can dip below principal due to credits

repaymentSchedule.scheduleTable[].outsta.name: per-diem penalty accrual
repaymentSchedule.scheduleTable[].outsta.gotchas: Per-row daily accrual; 'periodCharge'/'due' on an accrual row is the per-diem

disbursements[].amount.name: disbursement amount
disbursements[].amount.gotchas: Per-draw amount; sum across array for total drawn (cf. summary.totalDisbursed)

disbursements[].deductions.total.name: disbursement deductions total
disbursements[].deductions.total.gotchas: Amount netted out of a draw (e.g. origination fee)

terms[].approvedPrincipal.name: approved principal
terms[].approvedPrincipal.gotchas: Per-term version of commitment (example 30M) | Per-term restatement of the SAME commitment figure (example 30M = loan-level commitment), repeated once per term version. Do NOT sum across terms[] — take the latest/approved term only; summing double-counts the commitment.

terms[].maturityDate.name: term maturity date
terms[].maturityDate.gotchas: Per-term maturity; loan-level maturity is endDate

terms[].date.name: term date
terms[].date.gotchas: terms[] is versioned; latest entry is current

terms[].fees[].value.name: fee rate/value
terms[].fees[].value.gotchas: When percent-based this is a PERCENT (example 4 = 4%), not a fraction

valuations[].valuation.name: collateral valuation
valuations[].valuation.gotchas: Empty for this loan; the appraisal/AsIs value used for LTV | This is an absolute collateral value in money (appraisal / As-Is dollars), NOT an LTV ratio — the figure tag 'ltv' is misleading. LTV must be COMPUTED as outstanding/valuation; never render this dollar value as a percent.

owner.name.name: loan owner / deal lead
owner.name.gotchas: Internal OKOA staffer, not the borrower

deal.facilitySize.name: deal facility size
deal.facilitySize.gotchas: deal block is absent on this loan; redundant with commitment when present

taxRules[].vat.name: VAT rate
taxRules[].vat.gotchas: Likely a PERCENT; empty for this loan

commitmentAmountInFundingEntityCurrency.name: funding commitment (funder currency)
commitmentAmountInFundingEntityCurrency.gotchas: FX-converted twin of commitmentAmount; equals it when funder currency == loan currency

participationPercentage.name: participation percentage
participationPercentage.gotchas: Percent not fraction (5.26 means 5.26%); it is share of the loan, not an interest rate

currentInterestRate.name: current interest rate
currentInterestRate.gotchas: Percent not fraction (14 means 14%); a value >1 is a percent

currentCompoundingInterestRate.name: current compounding (PIK) rate
currentCompoundingInterestRate.gotchas: Percent not fraction; null when no compounding/PIK component on this funding

currentOidRemainingCost.name: current OID remaining cost
currentOidRemainingCost.gotchas: null when no OID terms attached

duesCalculationMethod.name: dues calculation method
duesCalculationMethod.gotchas: Enum (e.g. AfterDisbursement); config not a number

cashReceived.total.name: cash received total (net)
cashReceived.total.gotchas: Net of fee/credit components; use .principal for an interest basis, not .total

cashReceived.principal.name: principal cash received
cashReceived.principal.gotchas: This is a component of cashReceived.total (which already nets principal + interest + fee/credit components). Do NOT add cashReceived.principal to cashReceived.total or sum the children alongside the parent — that double-counts. Pick the parent OR the components, never both.

receivables.total.name: total receivable (net)
receivables.total.gotchas: Net of fee/credit components; for an interest basis use .principal not .total

receivables.principal.name: principal receivable
receivables.principal.gotchas: Use this as the interest basis, not receivables.total | Mapped to two different figures across the catalog: receivables.principal=funding_outstanding here, while repaymentSchedule.summary.totalDisbursed and outstandingPrincipalBeforeAmortization are also tagged funding_outstanding/principal_outstanding. These are different bases (gross disbursed vs. before-amortization vs. current net principal receivable) and must not be summed or treated as interchangeable. receivables.principal is also a child of receivables.total — never add it to the parent.

repaymentSchedule.summary.compoundingInt.name: schedule compounding rate
repaymentSchedule.summary.compoundingInt.gotchas: Percent not fraction; null when no PIK

repaymentSchedule.summary.oidRate.name: OID rate
repaymentSchedule.summary.oidRate.gotchas: Percent not fraction; null when no OID

repaymentSchedule.updatedAt.name: schedule last-updated timestamp
repaymentSchedule.updatedAt.gotchas: DateTime of last schedule recompute; use as the as-of/freshness stamp

repaymentSchedule.loanKPIs.irr.name: IRR (funder)
repaymentSchedule.loanKPIs.irr.gotchas: Percent not fraction (13.69 = 13.69%); a money-typed KPI but it is a rate | IRR is a percent (13.69 = 13.69%) carried in a money-typed field. NEVER sum, average unweighted, or roll it up across fundings as if it were currency, and never format with a currency symbol. It is a per-funding rate.

repaymentSchedule.loanKPIs.expectedIrr.name: expected IRR
repaymentSchedule.loanKPIs.expectedIrr.gotchas: Percent not fraction; projection, can be negative

repaymentSchedule.loanKPIs.dpi.name: DPI
repaymentSchedule.loanKPIs.dpi.gotchas: Ratio/multiple, not money despite money type | DPI is a dimensionless multiple (e.g. 1.25x) carried in a money type. NEVER format as currency or sum across fundings; aggregating requires recomputing from distributions/paid-in, not adding DPIs.

repaymentSchedule.loanKPIs.tvpi.name: TVPI
repaymentSchedule.loanKPIs.tvpi.gotchas: Ratio/multiple, not money despite money type | TVPI is a dimensionless multiple (e.g. 1.40x) carried in a money type. NEVER format as currency or sum across fundings; aggregate by recomputing (distributed+residual)/paid-in, not by adding TVPIs.

repaymentSchedule.scheduleTable[].date.name: schedule row date
repaymentSchedule.scheduleTable[].date.gotchas: Per-row in the amortization schedule array

repaymentSchedule.scheduleTable[].type.name: schedule row type
repaymentSchedule.scheduleTable[].type.gotchas: Enum (Disbursement/Repayment/Accrual etc.); filter to find the right row

repaymentSchedule.scheduleTable[].princi.name: principal realized balance (row)
repaymentSchedule.scheduleTable[].princi.gotchas: Snapshot balance at that schedule row

repaymentSchedule.scheduleTable[].due.to.name: amount due (row, net)
repaymentSchedule.scheduleTable[].due.to.gotchas: Net of fee/credit components; an accrual row's 'due' on a daily row is the per-diem

repaymentSchedule.scheduleTable[].due.in.name: interest due (row) / per-diem
repaymentSchedule.scheduleTable[].due.in.gotchas: On an accrual row this 'due' interest is the per-diem (daily accrual); not cumulative | On an accrual row 'due interest' is the PER-DIEM (daily accrual rate), but on a payment/installment row the same field is the interest actually due that period. The meaning flips by row type — do not treat all rows uniformly, and never sum per-diem rows with payment-due rows.

repaymentSchedule.scheduleTable[].due.fe.name: due fee amount (row)
repaymentSchedule.scheduleTable[].due.fe.gotchas: Itemized fee within the row's due

repaymentSchedule.scheduleTable[].outsta.name: outstanding (row, net)
repaymentSchedule.scheduleTable[].outsta.gotchas: Net of fee/credit components; use .principal for interest basis

repaymentSchedule.scheduleTable[].outsta.name: capitalized balance memo (row)
repaymentSchedule.scheduleTable[].outsta.gotchas: NON-additive memo field; equals principal — do not add to other balances

loanFundingTerms[].date.name: funding terms effective-as-of date
loanFundingTerms[].date.gotchas: loanFundingTerms is a versioned array; latest row = current terms

loanFundingTerms[].maturityDate.name: maturity date
loanFundingTerms[].maturityDate.gotchas: On the terms array; take the current/latest terms row

loanFundingTerms[].decreasedCompoundingP.name: decreased compounding payment percent
loanFundingTerms[].decreasedCompoundingP.gotchas: Percent not fraction; niche PIK config

fees[].assetFee.value.name: fee value
fees[].assetFee.value.gotchas: For Flat calc this is a money amount; for Percentage calc it is a percent — check calculationType | Polymorphic by calculationType: Flat => a money amount; Percentage => a percent (not a fraction, and not dollars). MUST branch on calculationType before using or summing — never aggregate Flat and Percentage values together, and never treat a Percentage value as a dollar fee.

fees[].assetFee.calculationType.name: fee calculation type
fees[].assetFee.calculationType.gotchas: Tells whether assetFee.value is money or a percent

fees[].allocationPercentage.name: fee allocation percent to funder
fees[].allocationPercentage.gotchas: Percent not fraction; funder's share of the fee

debtSell[].date.name: debt sale date
debtSell[].date.gotchas: empty for this entity; array of secondary sales

interestRatesData[].finalRate.name: interest rate history - final rate
interestRatesData[].finalRate.gotchas: Percent not fraction; versioned rate history (empty for this entity)

interestRatesData[].margin.name: interest rate history - margin
interestRatesData[].margin.gotchas: Spread over base; typed money but is a rate component (percent) | Margin is a rate spread (percent, e.g. 3.5 = 3.50%) carried in a money type. NEVER treat as a dollar amount or sum; combine with baseRate to reconstruct finalRate. Confirm it is not already a fraction by cross-checking baseRate + margin ≈ finalRate.

compoundingInterestRatesData[].finalRate.name: compounding rate history - final rate
compoundingInterestRatesData[].finalRate.gotchas: Percent not fraction; PIK rate history (empty here)

valuations[].valuation.name: valuation amount
valuations[].valuation.gotchas: Array of valuations over time; empty for this entity

deal.facilitySize.name: deal facility size
deal.facilitySize.gotchas: On parent deal (absent for this funding); whole-loan, not the funder's share

currentAverageInterestRate.name: current average interest rate
currentAverageInterestRate.gotchas: Rate is a PERCENT not a fraction (e.g. 9.35 means 9.35%).

utilizationRate.name: utilization rate
utilizationRate.gotchas: Percent not fraction; can exceed 100 (example 106.77) when disbursed > commitment. | Percent, NOT a fraction (example 106.77 = 106.77%). Can exceed 100 when disbursed > commitment — do NOT clamp to 100% and do NOT divide by 100 expecting a 0-1 ratio without confirming the consumer wants a fraction.

lastScheduleUpdate.name: last schedule update
lastScheduleUpdate.gotchas: As-of timestamp for the computed figures, not a loan date.

cashReceived.total.name: cash received total
cashReceived.total.gotchas: Roll-up of cashReceived.principal + .interest + .compoundingInterest. Non-additive memo — do NOT sum it together with its component fields, and do NOT add it to other entities' .total unless de-duped.

cashReceived.totalWithTaxes.name: cash received incl. taxes
cashReceived.totalWithTaxes.gotchas: Memo total including tax line; equals .total here when taxes are 0.

commitmentBreakdown.active.percentage.name: active commitment share
commitmentBreakdown.active.percentage.gotchas: Percent of total commitment, not a fraction.

kpis.irr.name: IRR
kpis.irr.gotchas: value_kind tagged money but this is a PERCENT (example 18.45 = 18.45%). | IRR is a PERCENT mis-tagged value_kind=money. Example 18.45 = 18.45% (not $18.45, not 0.1845). Never currency-format; if charting as fraction divide by 100.

kpis.dpi.name: DPI
kpis.dpi.gotchas: A multiple (x), not money/percent despite kind=money. | DPI is a MULTIPLE (x), not money — value_kind=money is wrong. Example 0.6 means 0.6x distributed-to-paid-in, NOT $0.60. Never sum, never currency-format, never aggregate across entities.

kpis.tvpi.name: TVPI
kpis.tvpi.gotchas: A multiple (x), not money despite kind=money. | TVPI is a MULTIPLE (x), not money — value_kind=money is wrong. Example 1.18 means 1.18x total-value-to-paid-in. Never currency-format or sum across entities.

mergedLoanFundingsSummary.totalDisbursed.name: total disbursed (summary)
mergedLoanFundingsSummary.totalDisbursed.gotchas: Same basis as top-level totalDisbursement / portfolio_disbursement. These are two views of the SAME disbursed dollars — do NOT add mergedLoanFundingsSummary.totalDisbursed to totalDisbursement; pick one source.

mergedLoanFundingsSummary.outstandingPri.name: outstanding principal before amortization
mergedLoanFundingsSummary.outstandingPri.gotchas: Before amortization adjustments; differs from totalOutstanding.principal. | Pre-amortization figure tagged portfolio_outstanding, but it differs from totalOutstanding.principal (the post-amortization, true current basis). Do NOT use this as the interest/current-outstanding basis and do NOT sum it with totalOutstanding.principal — they are the same loans before vs after amortization.

mergedLoanFundingsSummary.paidInCapital.name: paid-in capital
mergedLoanFundingsSummary.paidInCapital.gotchas: Carries the same portfolio_contributed figure as the top-level contributed field. Same dollars from two paths — do NOT sum paidInCapital with contributed; they are duplicate representations of paid-in capital.

mergedLoanFundingsSummary.totalExpected..name: total expected (all components)
mergedLoanFundingsSummary.totalExpected..gotchas: Net total across components. | Net total across components (principal + interest + compounding, net of fee/credit lines which can be negative). Do NOT treat as a simple gross sum of the component fields, and do NOT add it to component figures — it already aggregates them (non-additive memo).

mergedLoanFundingsSummary.totalExpectedT.name: total expected to date
mergedLoanFundingsSummary.totalExpectedT.gotchas: As-of-today slice of expected; equals lifetime expected here.

mergedLoanFundingsSummary.totalOutstandi.name: total outstanding
mergedLoanFundingsSummary.totalOutstandi.gotchas: NET of fee/credit components (totalFees here is negative); use .principal for an interest basis. | NET of fee/credit components (totalFees here is negative), so it is LOWER than gross principal owed. Wrong basis for interest accrual or 'amount outstanding' headline — use .principal for the principal basis; only use .total for a net-of-credits balance.

mergedLoanFundingsSummary.totalOutstandi.name: outstanding principal
mergedLoanFundingsSummary.totalOutstandi.gotchas: Use this (not .total) as the interest basis; .total is net of fee/credit lines.

mergedLoanFundingsSummary.totalOutstandi.name: outstanding fees
mergedLoanFundingsSummary.totalOutstandi.gotchas: Can be negative (credit); example -1.37M. Folds into totalOutstanding.total.

mergedLoanFundingsSummary.totalOutstandi.name: capitalized balance
mergedLoanFundingsSummary.totalOutstandi.gotchas: NON-additive memo; do not add to principal/interest (tracks capitalized component).

mergedLoanFundingsSummary.totalDue.total.name: total due
mergedLoanFundingsSummary.totalDue.total.gotchas: Sign convention: negative example means a credit/not-yet-due position, not money owed. | Sign convention: a NEGATIVE example is a credit / not-yet-due position, not money owed. Do NOT report magnitude as 'amount due'; check sign first — positive = owed, negative = credit balance. Mislabeling sign flips the meaning.

mergedLoanFundingsSummary.overdue.total.name: total overdue
mergedLoanFundingsSummary.overdue.total.gotchas: Sign convention: example is negative; interpret magnitude as overdue exposure. | Sign convention: example is NEGATIVE; overdue exposure is the magnitude (abs value). Do NOT deliver the raw negative as 'overdue amount' and do NOT sum signed values across loans without normalizing sign first.

mergedLoanFundingsSummary.exchangeRateIm.name: FX impact total
mergedLoanFundingsSummary.exchangeRateIm.gotchas: Only meaningful for multi-currency; 0 for USD entities.

mergedLoanFundingsSummary.interestRate.name: summary interest rate
mergedLoanFundingsSummary.interestRate.gotchas: Percent not fraction when populated; null on this entity.

receivables.total.name: receivables total
receivables.total.gotchas: Net total across components. | Net total across components (net of fee/credit lines that may be negative). Non-additive with its own .principal/.interest children — summing total + components double-counts. Use .principal alone for a principal basis.

cashReceived.fees[].amount.name: cash-received fee line amount
cashReceived.fees[].amount.gotchas: Per-fee breakdown row; empty on this entity.

cashReceived.penalties[].amount.name: cash-received penalty line amount
cashReceived.penalties[].amount.gotchas: Per-penalty breakdown row; empty on this entity.

mergedLoanFundingsSummary.totalOutstandi.name: outstanding fee line - total due
mergedLoanFundingsSummary.totalOutstandi.gotchas: Deep per-fee permutation; empty on this entity.

mergedLoanFundingsSummary.totalOutstandi.name: outstanding fee line - outstanding
mergedLoanFundingsSummary.totalOutstandi.gotchas: Deep per-fee permutation; empty on this entity.

mergedLoanFundingsSummary.totalOutstandi.name: outstanding fee line - value/rate
mergedLoanFundingsSummary.totalOutstandi.gotchas: Could be a percent or money depending on calculationType; deep niche, empty here.

numOfActiveLoans.name: borrower active loan count
numOfActiveLoans.gotchas: Borrower-level count across all of this client's loans, not portfolio-wide; do not confuse with portfolio_active_loans.

numOfPendingLoans.name: borrower pending loan count
numOfPendingLoans.gotchas: Pending (not yet funded) loans for this borrower only.

currentCommitment.name: borrower total commitment
currentCommitment.gotchas: Sum of commitment across this borrower's loans; borrower-level roll-up, not a single-loan commitment.

outstandingBalance.name: borrower outstanding balance
outstandingBalance.gotchas: Borrower-level aggregate across loans; may be NET of fee/credit components like loan-level totalOutstanding.total — confirm vs loan principalOutstanding for an interest basis. | Borrower-level outstandingBalance is an aggregate that, like loan-level totalOutstanding.total, may be NET of fee/credit components. It is the WRONG basis for interest accrual or principal-exposure questions. For an interest/principal basis, sum the loan-level principalOutstanding across this borrower's loans rather than using this net roll-up; reconcile the two before delivering an exposure figure.

totalOverdue.name: borrower total overdue
totalOverdue.gotchas: Borrower-level overdue across all loans, not a single loan.

warrantsValue.name: borrower warrants value
warrantsValue.gotchas: Equity-kicker memo value, not part of debt outstanding.

sharesValue.name: borrower shares value
sharesValue.gotchas: Equity holding value, not part of debt outstanding.

loans.totalFilteredRecords.name: borrower loan count
loans.totalFilteredRecords.gotchas: Count of all loans (any status) for this borrower.

dataApplications.pageItems[].status.name: application status
dataApplications.pageItems[].status.gotchas: DataApplicationStatus enum, application workflow only — not loan status.

dataApplications.pageItems[].secondsToCo.name: application completion time
dataApplications.pageItems[].secondsToCo.gotchas: Duration in seconds, not a money value.

allocations[].numberOfUnits.name: allocated units
allocations[].numberOfUnits.gotchas: value_kind is money but this is a unit/share count, not a dollar amount | value_kind=money but this is a unit/SHARE COUNT, not dollars. Never format as currency or sum into a money total.

equityKPIs.tvpi.name: TVPI
equityKPIs.tvpi.gotchas: a multiple (e.g. 1.8x), not money despite value_kind money; not a percent | TVPI is a MULTIPLE (e.g. 1.8x), not money despite value_kind=money and not a percent. Do not currency-format, do not multiply by 100, do not sum.

equityKPIs.bvToCost.name: book value to cost
equityKPIs.bvToCost.gotchas: a multiple, not money despite value_kind money | Book-value-to-cost is a MULTIPLE (ratio), not money despite value_kind=money. Do not currency-format or sum.

exerciseEntries[].numberOfExercisedUnits.name: exercised units
exerciseEntries[].numberOfExercisedUnits.gotchas: value_kind money but this is a unit/share count | value_kind=money but this is a unit/SHARE COUNT, not dollars. Do not treat as currency or roll into money aggregates.

expectedTransactions[].rateToBaseCurrenc.name: FX rate to base currency
expectedTransactions[].rateToBaseCurrenc.gotchas: an FX conversion rate, not an interest rate | This is an FX CONVERSION RATE, not an interest rate and not money. Do not treat as a yield/percent; it is the multiplier used to convert the transaction currency to base currency.

expectedTransactions[].numberOfUnits.name: expected units
expectedTransactions[].numberOfUnits.gotchas: value_kind money but this is a unit/share count

expectedTransactions[].loanTransaction.d.name: linked-loan distribution total
expectedTransactions[].loanTransaction.d.gotchas: NET of fee/credit components; use .principal for an interest basis

expectedTransactions[].loanTransaction.o.name: linked-loan outstanding balance
expectedTransactions[].loanTransaction.o.gotchas: snapshot tied to this linked-loan txn, not the equity itself

expectedTransactions[].loanTransaction.r.name: linked-loan FX rate
expectedTransactions[].loanTransaction.r.gotchas: FX rate, not an interest rate | FX conversion rate on the linked loan transaction, not an interest rate or money. Do not misread as a yield.

expectedTransactions[].loanTransaction.o.name: OID override rate
expectedTransactions[].loanTransaction.o.gotchas: PERCENT not fraction (e.g. 14 means 14%) | OID override rate is a PERCENT, not a fraction (e.g. 14 means 14%, not 0.14). Do not divide by 100 a second time or treat as a 0..1 fraction in interest math.

expectedTransactions[].loanTransaction.o.name: override outstanding total
expectedTransactions[].loanTransaction.o.gotchas: NET of fee/credit components; use .principal for interest basis

expectedTransactions[].loanTransaction.o.name: override amount due total
expectedTransactions[].loanTransaction.o.gotchas: NET total; use components for breakdown

expectedTransactions[].loanTransaction.t.name: linked equity-txn units
expectedTransactions[].loanTransaction.t.gotchas: value_kind money but this is a unit/share count

expectedTransactions[].loanTransaction.o.name: OID override rate (alt)
expectedTransactions[].loanTransaction.o.gotchas: PERCENT not fraction | Alt OID override rate is a PERCENT, not a fraction (e.g. 14 means 14%). Mirror handling of override.oid.rate; pick one canonical path to avoid double-counting two override fields for the same loan.

fundingSources[].investor.kpis.irr.name: investor IRR
fundingSources[].investor.kpis.irr.gotchas: likely a percent/rate despite value_kind money; an example >1 means percent | IRR is a PERCENT/rate, not money despite value_kind money. Confirm whether the raw value is already in percent (e.g. 18 = 18%) or a fraction (0.18). An example >1 means it is delivered as a percent and must NOT be multiplied by 100 again, nor summed as a dollar amount.

fundingSources[].investor.kpis.dpi.name: investor DPI
fundingSources[].investor.kpis.dpi.gotchas: a multiple, not money despite value_kind money | DPI is a MULTIPLE (distributions/paid-in), not money despite value_kind=money. Do not currency-format or sum across investors.

fundingSources[].investor.totalDistribut.name: distributed by entity to investor
fundingSources[].investor.totalDistribut.gotchas: directional: amount the entity paid to this investor | Directional: amount the ENTITY PAID OUT to this investor. Do not confuse with distributions received from a target; verify direction before netting against contributions.

fundingSources[].investor.totalCommitmen.name: investor commitment to entity
fundingSources[].investor.totalCommitmen.gotchas: directional: investor's commitment into this entity | Directional figure: investor's commitment INTO this entity. Do not conflate with funding-source-level commitment or with amounts the entity owes out; ensure direction (investor->entity) matches the question before summing.

fundingSources[].investor.totalInvestedI.name: invested in entity
fundingSources[].investor.totalInvestedI.gotchas: directional: invested into this entity | Directional: amount invested INTO this entity (portfolio_contributed). Distinct from commitment (may be unfunded) and from totalInvestedInTarget at the funding-source level; do not double-count both the investor-level and funding-source-level invested figures.

fundingSources[].investor.cashAvailabili.name: investor cash availability balance
fundingSources[].investor.cashAvailabili.gotchas: time-series point; expected flag marks forecast vs actual

fundingSources[].commitmentPercentage.name: funding-source commitment percentage
fundingSources[].commitmentPercentage.gotchas: a percentage share of total commitment | Percentage share of total commitment (funding_participation). Confirm percent (e.g. 25 = 25%) vs fraction (0.25) before deriving a dollar amount; do not sum across sources unless reconciling to 100%.

summary.shareholding.name: shareholding percentage
